analysis.session_summary: USD and JPY led the tape, with USD strength 0.292% and JPY 0.279% recovering from early selling. GBP was the clear laggard at -0.269% despite inline UK CPI; EUR and CHF also softened. Hawkish Fed Waller comments reinforced the USD bid, while ECB and BoE appearances produced only muted or unscored reactions. DXY gained 0.368% and VIX fell 3.173%, signaling a benign risk backdrop for dollar strength.

JPY sold to -0.05% then recovered 84%; strength_pct 0.279
